ask: How many active customers do we have?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE is_active
SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE is_discontinued

ask: How many sales reps are active?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales_reps WHERE is_active

ask: How many sales orders were placed in September 2026?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

ask: How many orders have been cancelled in total?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

ask: How many sales orders are open right now?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'open'

ask: Which product category had the highest sales revenue in 2025?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(l.qty * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) DESC LIMIT 1

ask: Which customer segment pays its invoices latest on average?
sql: SELECT c.segment FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(p.paid_at - i.due_date) DESC LIMIT 1

ask: Which region's order count fell between July 2026 and September 2026?
sql: SELECT r.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01') < count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-08-01')

ask: What is the total unpaid invoice balance right now?
sql: SELECT round(sum(amount) - (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount), 0) FROM payments), 2) FROM invoices
